description: This source file defines the HomeBrowseFragment class for an Android TV app using Leanback. It manages UI components for browsing categories, favorites, recent items, and workouts, utilizing RecyclerViews with custom presenters. It also includes presenter classes for workout and category cards.

classes.name: HomeBrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays categorized rows of workout and category items in a TV app using the Leanback library. Handles loading data, setting up UI, and navigation.

classes.name: WorkoutCardPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class for rendering workout items as image cards in the Leanback UI.

classes.name: CategoryCardPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class for rendering category items as image cards in the Leanback UI.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holders for workout and category cards.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from WorkoutItem or CategoryItem to the respective card views.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Handles cleanup when view holders are unbound (empty implementations).
